c: Fill Configuration item (or Service, or Service offering) on the incident.
say: Start by filling the configuration item on the incident, or its service or service offering.

c: Choose the tree icon beside the field: CI dependency view. It shows only when the field has a value.
say: Choose the tree icon beside the field. It appears only when the field has a value, and any agent can use it.

c: A Map tab opens, centred on the CI, five levels deep. Filter it, or open a CI in a new map.
say: A map tab opens in the workspace, centred on the item, with five levels of connections around it.

c: The incident's CI is kept in Affected CIs. Add others from the overview's Impact section.
say: The incident's own item is kept in the affected CIs list for you. Add any others you find.

c: Refresh impacted services rebuilds Impacted Services/CIs from the CI, in the background.
say: Refresh impacted services rebuilds the list of services hit, from the incident's item. Services you added by hand stay.

c: Use what you found to set the Impact, or to propose a major incident.
say: Use what you found to set the impact, or to propose a major incident when many services are hit.
